detailed_descriptions_html.en:
No AI was used in the development of this game!!!

A giant asteroid is about to destroy the Earth!

Play solo or in online co-op with up to 3 friends! Build a tower all the way to the Moon, deliver a powerful laser, and save humanity before it's too late!

Build a Tower

Your goal is the Moon!

To get there - use anything you can find to build the tallest tower, from fences and boxes to houses and clouds.
A Gravity Gun will come in handy...

Upgrade & Go Higher

As you climb higher, you earn rewards like new abilities, items, or points used to upgrade your gear.

The higher you go, the crazier skills you get.

Bring the Laser

Once the tower is ready - work together to bring the laser you built in your garage to the top and explode that rock!'

Totally Safe Moon Project is all about shared moments, creativity, and joyful chaos. There is no competition and no pressure, just teamwork and the simple question of how far you can get together.

Features:

  • Build a totally safe tower to the Moon!
